title: Per-facet Cost Orchestration UI Spec — token breakdown, attribution & export flows
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Goal: Design an orchestration-focused UI for per-facet cost visibility at token/message granularity that supports rapid attribution, filterable exports, and pricing pattern suggestions. The scope covers the Console’s Cost > Insights area: (1) an interactive breakdown panel that surfaces per-route/per-model/per-prompt-token line-items, (2) an attribution ribbon for multi-tenant/role-aware charge allocation, and (3) export flows (CSV/Parquet + schema, sample row-level redact rules) for finance and platform teams. Non-goals: full billing engine changes, changes to backend pricing calculation logic, or accounting reconciliation workflows. Deliverables: high-fidelity Figma frames (desktop + responsive), click-through prototype for PM/Eng validation, export schema doc, and acceptance criteria for engineering handoff.
acceptance_criteria: Interactive breakdown panel shows top 10 line-items by cost and supports drill-to-requests (max 1000 rows)
Attribution ribbon can apply rules (user/team/model) and produce a reconciliable export with row-level tags
Export UI supports two presets (Finance: aggregated, Platform: row-level) and an advanced mode for custom field selection
All color/legend/accessibility choices meet AA contrast and pass keyboard-only navigation tests
Design tokens and component specs provided for engineering with clear responsive behavior
decisions: Prefer incremental beta behind feature flag scoped to Dedicated customers for initial rollout
Export format will include an anonymized request hash instead of raw prompt text by default; raw prompts available only with tenant permission and audit log
Default view will surface 'cost per effective token' (cost/token after batching & caching adjustments) rather than raw token count to align with runtime billing signals
